%%bash
set -Eeuo pipefail

# ============================================================
# FINAL SESSION SESSION_001_FAST_COMBINED
# Expected wall time: ~6.5-8.5 h expected (planning estimate, target >6h and <12h)
# Hard stop: 11 h 20 min for the WHOLE Kaggle cell.
# Only manuscript-missing rows are run.
# Combines the sub-6h small jobs so the planned session is above 6h.
# ============================================================

SESSION_ID="SESSION_001_FAST_COMBINED"
SESSION_BUDGET_SECONDS=40800
SESSION_RESERVE_SECONDS=240
SESSION_START_TS=$(date +%s)
SESSION_DEADLINE_TS=$((SESSION_START_TS + SESSION_BUDGET_SECONDS))
SESSION_ZIP="/kaggle/working/${SESSION_ID}_ALL_CURRENT_EXPORTS.zip"

CHILD_JOBS=("U01_USPS_MV3S_10ep_FINAL_missing3" "N02_Flowers17_MV3S_10ep_FINAL_all10" "N01_STL10_EffB0_10ep_FINAL_all10" "N04_Flowers17_R18_100ep_FINAL_linear")

pack_session_exports() {
  python - <<'PYSESSIONPACK'
import os, zipfile, glob, json, time
from pathlib import Path
dst=Path(os.environ["SESSION_ZIP"])
jobs=os.environ["SESSION_CHILD_JOBS"].split(",") if os.environ.get("SESSION_CHILD_JOBS") else []
found=[]
for job in jobs:
    found += [Path(p) for p in glob.glob(f"/kaggle/working/{job}*.zip")]
found=sorted(set(found))
tmp=dst.with_name(dst.name+".tmp")
tmp.unlink(missing_ok=True)
with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp,"w",zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED,compresslevel=6) as z:
    manifest={"session_id":os.environ["SESSION_ID"],"jobs":jobs,"created_epoch":int(time.time()),"exports":[p.name for p in found]}
    z.writestr("SESSION_EXPORT_MANIFEST.json",json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+"\n")
    for p in found: z.write(p,p.name)
tmp.replace(dst)
print("SESSION EXPORT ZIP:",dst)
print("Included:",[p.name for p in found])
PYSESSIONPACK
  ls -lh "$SESSION_ZIP" || true
}

export SESSION_ID SESSION_ZIP
SESSION_CHILD_JOBS="$(IFS=,; echo "${CHILD_JOBS[*]}")"
export SESSION_CHILD_JOBS

on_session_exit() {
  local rc=$?
  trap - EXIT
  pack_session_exports || true
  exit "$rc"
}
trap on_session_exit EXIT

# ---- Child 1: U01 missing Residual + LoRA-Conv + Side-Tuning ----
now=$(date +%s)
remaining=$((SESSION_DEADLINE_TS-now-SESSION_RESERVE_SECONDS))
if (( remaining < 900 )); then
  echo "Not enough global session time remains to safely start the next child."
  pack_session_exports
  trap - EXIT
  exit 124
fi
TMP_CHILD="/kaggle/working/${SESSION_ID}_child_01.sh"
base64 -d > "$TMP_CHILD" <<'__CHILD_B64__'

__CHILD_B64__
chmod +x "$TMP_CHILD"
echo "============================================================"
echo "START CHILD 1: U01 missing Residual + LoRA-Conv + Side-Tuning"
echo "Remaining WHOLE-session budget: ${remaining}s"
echo "============================================================"
set +e
DT1D_CELL_BUDGET_SECONDS="$remaining" bash "$TMP_CHILD"
child_rc=$?
set -e
pack_session_exports || true
if [[ "$child_rc" -ne 0 ]]; then
  echo "Child 1 stopped/failed rc=$child_rc; ending this Kaggle session safely."
  trap - EXIT
  exit "$child_rc"
fi

# ---- Child 2: N02 all 10 currently blank methods ----

remaining=$((SESSION_DEADLINE_TS-now-SESSION_RESERVE_SECONDS))
if (( remaining < 900 )); then
  echo "Not enough global session time remains to safely start the next child."
  pack_session_exports
  trap - EXIT
  exit 124
fi
TMP_CHILD="/kaggle/working/${SESSION_ID}_child_02.sh"
base64 -d > "$TMP_CHILD" <<'__CHILD_B64__'

__CHILD_B64__
chmod +x "$TMP_CHILD"

echo "============================================================"
set +e
DT1D_CELL_BUDGET_SECONDS="$remaining" bash "$TMP_CHILD"

if [[ "$child_rc" -ne 0 ]]; then

  trap - EXIT
  exit "$child_rc"
fi

if (( remaining < 900 )); then

  pack_session_exports

  exit 124
fi
TMP_CHILD="/kaggle/working/${SESSION_ID}_child_03.sh"
base64 -d > "$TMP_CHILD" <<'__CHILD_B64__'

echo "Remaining WHOLE-session budget: ${remaining}s"
echo "============================================================"
set +e
DT1D_CELL_BUDGET_SECONDS="$remaining" bash "$TMP_CHILD"

if [[ "$child_rc" -ne 0 ]]; then

  trap - EXIT
  exit "$child_rc"
fi

# ---- Child 4: N04 Linear probing ----
now=$(date +%s)
remaining=$((SESSION_DEADLINE_TS-now-SESSION_RESERVE_SECONDS))
if (( remaining < 900 )); then

  pack_session_exports

  exit 124
fi
TMP_CHILD="/kaggle/working/${SESSION_ID}_child_04.sh"
base64 -d > "$TMP_CHILD" <<'__CHILD_B64__'

__CHILD_B64__
chmod +x "$TMP_CHILD"
echo "============================================================"
echo "START CHILD 4: N04 Linear probing"
echo "Remaining WHOLE-session budget: ${remaining}s"
echo "============================================================"
set +e
DT1D_CELL_BUDGET_SECONDS="$remaining" bash "$TMP_CHILD"
child_rc=$?
set -e

if [[ "$child_rc" -ne 0 ]]; then

fi

pack_session_exports
trap - EXIT
echo "FINAL SESSION COMPLETE: $SESSION_ID"
